subject: Re: Handover meeting
text: Quick follow-up on your note. Before you send the invite, could you ask the vendor whether the morning slot works? I know you suggested 4 p.m., but if the courier arrives early, the warehouse team will be in the unloading bay and we will miss the inspection window. A 10 a.m. call might keep everyone at the table for the walkthrough, assuming the supervisor is back from the site visit by then. If the morning is impossible, then the afternoon option is fine, but let me know before noon so I can ask another team to cover the loading desk. I would rather not split the session into two parts, though that is an alternative if all else fails.
